cards.title: Liquid AI Releases QAD Q4_0 Checkpoints for LFM2.5 Edge Models, Recovering ~97% of BF16 Accuracy
cards.why_it_matters: If you deploy or benchmark quantized models on edge hardware, this is a concrete, reproducible method that closes most of the PTQ accuracy gap at no extra runtime cost.
cards.summary: Liquid AI used Quantization-Aware Distillation (QAD) — a BF16 teacher distilled into a Q4_0 student — across four LFM2.5 models (230M, 350M, 1.2B, 2.6B). The checkpoints recover 96.5–97.4% of BF16 accuracy lost to standard PTQ, match Q5_K_M quality (230M/350M) or Q4_K_M quality (1.2B/2.6B), and achieve 3–33% higher decode throughput. All four GGUF checkpoints are available on Hugging Face for llama.cpp.
